I have farmed this land for many years, and I know the soil is tired, so I will spread manure from my livestock before planting to give the millet some strength. I also managed to get one bag of subsidized NPK fertilizer from the agro-dealer, which I will apply to this plot, though it is not enough for the whole hectare. I will plant the millet seed I saved from last season because it is what I trust, and I will rely on the June rains since we have no irrigation here. My children and I will do all the work ourselves—we cannot afford to hire laborers when there is no credit available.
